vibe: Modern Streetwear, Brutalist E-commerce, Underground UK Fashion

layout_strategies.general: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse style layouts where possible. 1px solid borders separating sections and items. Asymmetry in hero sections.
layout_strategies.hero: Inverted layout or split grid. Massive uppercase typography, overlapping images, overlay max bg-black/40. Consider a slow-moving marquee for brand names.
layout_strategies.product_grid: Bento-style or strict technical grid. Images should fill the cell. No gap between grid lines if using border-collapse.
layout_strategies.brand_of_the_week: Dominant asymmetrical section. Span multiple columns. Use neon green accents for the 'Boosted' or 'Featured' badges.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: Ensure you import 'Clash Display' and 'Satoshi' via standard CDN (e.g. Fontshare) in the index.html or global css.
LAYOUT: Do not use rounded cards. Everything must be sharp, 0px border-radius (rounded-none), with 1px borders (border-white/10). This gives the brutalist streetwear edge.
HERO OVERLAYS: If text is placed over images, ensure max bg-black/50 overlay. Use text-shadow if necessary for contrast.
CTA BUTTONS: The primary action (Buy, Submit Application, Checkout) MUST use the primary neon green (#39FF14) with black text. Do not overuse it elsewhere. Keep secondary buttons silver/transparent.
TESTING: Add data-testid attributes (kebab-case) to all interactive elements (buttons, nav links, form inputs) as per the guidelines.
MARQUEE: Add a slow marquee using 'react-fast-marquee' in the hero or footer section containing trending independent UK brand names (e.g., 'Corteiz', 'Trapstar', 'Unknown London', 'Represent').
FORMS: Use Shadcn UI for forms, but override the rounded corners to rounded-none and apply the dark brutalist styling (transparent bg, border-b or full border).
DATA: For mock data, ensure all products are UK streetwear vibe (Hoodies, Cargos, Puffer Jackets, Graphic Tees, Sneakers).
BRANDING: Use big, bold, oversized text for category names and brand sections. Don't be afraid to overlap text with images.
ICONS: lucide-react is already installed. Use it for all UI icons. Keep stroke width crisp (1.5 or 2).
